messages:
maya: heads up — release candidate v2.3.1 blocked by CI. container-setup step failing with auth errors to our internal registry. logs show 403 on pulling base image.
chris: can you paste the log? is this the ghcr rate limit or our runner creds?
eng-ci-bot: pipeline #5892 failed on step `container-setup` (exit 1). https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/5892
maya: log snippet: ```
Error: failed to resolve image "ghcr.io/redwood-inference/base:latest": received status code 403
  at github.com/containerd/containerd/remotes/docker.(*resolver).Resolve
  at ...
Caused by: GET https://ghcr.io/v2/redwood-inference/base/manifests/latest: 403 Forbidden
```
sasha: saw a spike of 403s from the eu-west runner pool ~10:10 UTC. Might be short-lived GHCR auth expiry; others retried and passed earlier.
chris: if it's intermittent, we should pin the base image to a digest in the pipeline as a quick mitigation. Also add a retry header or fallback mirror.
maya: release window is 17:00 UTC today. product is waiting. we need a decision: hold or rollback?
devops: I'm going to rotate the runner GHCR token and restart the credential-refresher service on the runner pool, ETA ~8–10m. I'll post here when done.
chris: temporary PR ready to pin digest + add a public mirror fallback: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3424 — will trigger a new pipeline once merged.
eng-ci-bot: queued pipeline #5893 (triggered by chris/infra#3424).
deploy-bot: promotion for v2.3.1 is blocked: no successful build artifact.
maya: okay — decision: hold the release for up to 30m while we try the hotfix. if pipeline still fails, we rollback to v2.3.0 candidate and notify product.
sasha: note — if we rollback we must update release notes and disable the canary promotion in the console to avoid accidental rollouts. cc @product. :eyes:
eng-ci-bot: pipeline #5893: container-setup step retried.
eng-ci-bot: pipeline #5893: container-setup succeeded. pulling pinned digest from mirror. build started.
eng-ci-bot: pipeline #5893: build succeeded, integration tests running.
sasha: I'll run a quick staging smoke once artifacts upload.
eng-ci-bot: pipeline #5893: all checks passed. artifacts uploaded. tag created: v2.3.1-candidate.
maya: unblocking release after green. I'll coordinate canary window and monitor latency/error budgets during canary. :thumbsup:
devops: follow-up ticket created for runner token rotation and longer-term fix: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INF-1256 — leaving a note in #incidents as well.
chris: merging infra PR now, will watch the promo.
deploy-bot: attempted promotion skipped (previous attempt blocked). ready for manual canary kick when ops confirms.
maya: thanks everyone — holding final promoting action until ops confirms metrics are stable for 10m. if any regression we rollback to last-good (v2.3.0).
